title: Tour: Business Profile
blurb: Your business name, logo, contact details, address and time zone.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Your business details live in **Settings**, at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Business Profile
steps.body: Click **Business Profile** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Your business details
steps.body: The top section, **General Information**, holds your logo, business names, email, phone, website and currency. These show up on invoices, emails and booking pages.

steps.title: Address and time zone
steps.body: Scroll to **Business Physical Address**. Your address and time zone sit here. The time zone controls when reminders and scheduled messages go out, so it matters.

steps.title: General switches
steps.body: Further down, **General** has switches for duplicate handling, SMS opt-out wording and unsubscribe links. Leave them alone unless a Luubu guide or our team tells you to change one.

steps.title: Save each section
steps.body: Each section saves on its own. After changing the top section, click **Update Information** before you scroll on.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Set your time zone to New Zealand** from the Guide. It only takes a minute.
